summary: Tested the Xoala sandbox host check on the backend and in the checkout UI. The backend correctly turns card payments off on live hosts (www.ghp-health.com, ghp-health.com, helixaris.com, and X-Forwarded-Host www.ghp-health.com): /config returns configured:false and create-payment returns 503. Card payments stay on for the preview domain: config is true and create-payment returns 200 with a sandbox action and signed fields for a real order. /return and /notify still work (the 7 tests in test_xoala.py pass). In the UI on preview, the Pay by Card button shows with the TEST MODE note and turns clickable once the research-use box is ticked. With /api/xoala/config mocked to configured:false, xoala-section is not rendered and Pay by Bank still shows. 14/16 backend tests pass. The 2 failures are a security finding: the check trusts the client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host. The live site still showed configured:true when we checked (read-only GET), which suggests the fix is not deployed yet.

minor.issue: The check trusts the client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host and matches it loosely: substring 'preview.emergentagent.com' and startswith('localhost'/'127.'). With Host www.ghp-health.com plus X-Forwarded-Host 'x.preview.emergentagent.com' or 'localhost.evil.com', configured:true comes back. On preview the ingress seems to overwrite X-Forwarded-Host, so spoofing had no effect there. We could not confirm this for the production ingress. If prod passes the header through, an attacker could create a live order, get a sandbox form, pay with a Xoala test card, and the signed return/notify would mark the real order as paid (free goods).

action_items: Make the sandbox check deployment-based rather than header-based. For example, set XOALA_ENABLED or XOALA_SANDBOX_ALLOWED=false in the prod env, or better, keep sandbox XOALA_* vars out of production. Alternatively, check the Host against an exact allowlist of preview hosts and ignore a client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host.
After deploying, confirm https://www.ghp-health.com/api/xoala/config returns configured:false. It returned configured:true at test time, so the fix is not live yet.
Optional: set XOALA_ENABLED=false in the production env so sandbox credentials can never reach live checkout.
critical_code_review_comments: xoala_routes.py:45-46 host check uses substring/startswith matching on a header the client controls. Use exact matching (e.g. host.split(':')[0] in ALLOWED or host.endswith('.preview.emergentagent.com')) and prefer an env flag.
Cart is not cleared after the order is created (the second checkout had qty 2). This may be intentional so a failed payment can be retried, but stale baskets could produce duplicate orders.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST orders (one in pytest, GHP-044 and GHP-045 in the UI test). All were deleted as admin and the counter was reset to 44 (next_order_will_be GHP-044). No payment was completed on Xoala.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_xoala_host_gating.py tests/test_xoala.py -p no:xdist -v. The spoof tests in test_xoala_host_gating.py will pass once _enabled_for stops trusting X-Forwarded-Host. Checkout: inputs are #email then unnamed inputs in this order: first, last, addr1, addr2, city, postcode, phone. Then click CONTINUE TO PAYMENT.
